Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Saṅghādisesa 6 (*Kiṁteavassutovāanavassutovā*, "Encouraging a nun to receive food from a man with lust") is an ecclesiastical training rule within the nun's disciplinary code (*Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga*) of the Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The rule establishes that a nun incurs an offense entailing suspension (*saṅghādisesa*) if she instigates or encourages another nun to receive almsfood or consumables from a lustful man [SuttaCentral]. An English translation of the rule and its exposition is provided by Bhikkhu Brahmali on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
